# Arize AX

Arize AX is an AI engineering platform for tracing, evaluating, and improving AI applications through projects, datasets, prompts, experiments, traces, and spans.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/arize-ax/.

## Actions

- **Add Dataset Examples**: Append arbitrary-field examples to an Arize dataset or a specified dataset version.
- **Add Experiment Runs**: Append one or more runs to an existing Arize experiment.
- **Create Dataset**: Create an Arize dataset in a space with an explicit initial array of examples.
- **Create Experiment**: Create an Arize experiment with initial runs, associated with exactly one dataset or space.
- **Create Prompt**: Create an Arize prompt and its initial version in a space.
- **Create Prompt Version**: Create a new immutable version of an existing Arize prompt.
- **Get Dataset** (read-only): Get one Arize dataset and its versions by dataset ID.
- **Get Experiment** (read-only): Get one Arize experiment by its ID, without its experiment runs.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Get one accessible Arize project by its ID.
- **Get Prompt** (read-only): Get an Arize prompt with its current, explicitly selected, or labeled version.
- **Get Space** (read-only): Get one accessible Arize space by its ID.
- **List Dataset Examples** (read-only): List one page of examples from an Arize dataset or a specific dataset version, preserving user-defined example fields.
- **List Datasets** (read-only): List one page of Arize datasets, optionally filtered by space or dataset name.
- **List Experiment Runs** (read-only): List one page of runs and outputs for an Arize experiment, preserving additional run fields.
- **List Experiments** (read-only): List one page of Arize experiments, optionally filtered by dataset, space, or name.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List one page of accessible Arize projects, optionally filtered by space or project name.
- **List Prompt Versions** (read-only): List one page of versions for an Arize prompt, newest first.
- **List Prompts** (read-only): List one page of Arize prompts, optionally filtered by space or prompt name.
- **List Spaces** (read-only): List one page of Arize spaces accessible to the connected API key, optionally filtered by organization or name.
- **List Spans** (read-only): Read one bounded page of spans for an Arize project using optional time and filter constraints.
- **List Traces** (read-only): Read one bounded page of traces and nested spans for an Arize project using optional time and filter constraints.
- **Update Dataset**: Rename an existing Arize dataset.
- **Update Dataset Examples**: Update existing Arize dataset examples by ID, optionally creating a named dataset version.
- **Update Prompt**: Update or clear an Arize prompt's description.
